gan_verified.description: CIFAR-10 subset of archived verified paired GAN results; original artifact also includes CIFAR-100.

gan_cluster_audit.description: Companion audit states all cluster runs used final_epoch selection at epoch 500; 12 MM+GAN cluster rows do not retain the original result object.

caveats: Configs retain only observed portable scientific fields; omitted values are not filled from current defaults.
The 12 MM+GAN cluster configurations are abbreviated in the source artifact.
Bag hashes are preserved and paired equality is checked; their original byte-level computation was not retained, so they are not enforced as hashes of newly generated NPZ bytes.
Archived evidence can regenerate summary statistics but does not establish a clean-environment training reproduction.
